anatomy_structure: Corrected realistic 3D virtual dissection of right hip with weight-bearing dome, osteonecrotic segment, marrow edema, subchondral fracture, femoral neck and restrained posterior vascular relationship; anatomy-only/no needling trajectory.
pain_location: Deep groin pain located in case and figure context; explicitly not diagnostic alone.
competing_diagnosis: OA, labrum, iliopsoas/adductor, lumbar and hernia branches included.
exam_posture: Right-sided gait, passive internal rotation and gentle log-roll with corrected laterality and non-confirmatory warning.
movement_loading: Walking tolerance, impact-load modification and 24-hour response included.
imaging_orientation: Coronal MRI orientation inset plus X-ray/MRI/CT role in decision figure.
rehab_progression: Temporary impact-load reduction and metrics tied to imaging/referral branch.
decision_branch: MRI-negative, ARCO I-II and fracture/collapse branches visualized.
red_flags: Fever, acute inability to bear weight, trauma and neurovascular deficit precede pathway.
safety_boundary: 압통점은 통증 단서이지 안전한 자침 경로가 아니다; no angle/depth/trajectory.
